prompt:
Render a desktop web application screen for the real GO Itaim “Dashboard Geral”, landscape 16:10, about 1440×900. Use the attached GO Itaim logo as the exact asset in the sidebar, preserving its shape, colors and proportions. No poster, no device frame, no invented product branding.

Commit to the Japanese high-density information-web system as a desktop interface: white ground; black and charcoal typography; fine gray rules; compact gothic sans; rectangular modules tiled in a strict grid; small utility-red module tabs; cobalt only for the selected navigation and data line. The page is data-dense but its labels remain comfortably readable. No Japanese characters, motifs, or cultural decoration.

Use only the following product structure and labels. Do not add modules, metrics, controls, roles, or menu items:
- A 238px fixed sidebar with the logo and “Dashboard Geral”.
- Under “Principal”: “Visão Geral”, “Análise”, “UTR”, “Comparação”.
- Under “Operacional”: “Entregadores”, “Valores”, “Prioridade | Promo”, “Evolução”, “Dedicado”.
- Under “Marketing”: “Operacional Marketing”, “Marketing”.
- Select “Visão Geral”.
- The top filter row contains only “Praça: Todas”, “2026 · Semanas 05–07”, and “Amostra ilustrativa”.
- Main title “Resumo Operacional”. Show three compact but prominent metric modules: “Corridas ofertadas 18.450”, “Aderência 74,8%”, “Praças 2”.
- Under those, show just two lower modules: a line chart titled “Evolução diária” with legend “Ofertadas” and “Aceitas”; a table titled “Por praça” with columns “Praça”, “Corridas”, “Aderência” and rows “Guarulhos”, “Centro”, “Total”. Use only plausible sample data consistent with the three headline values. Do not add comparison deltas or any extra metric.

The strict mosaic and tight alignment should read as the direction; three top modules, two bottom modules, exact existing navigation, no extra bottom cards. All text is Brazilian Portuguese with the spelling shown above. The purpose is obvious: quickly scan corridas, aderência and praças.
